source.baseStandard:
1. 성상 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 자주색의 타원형 제피정제
2. 비타민C : 표시량(500mg/1100mg)의 80~150%
3. 비타민E : 표시량(11mg/1100mg)의 80~150%
4. 비타민D : 표시량(10ug/1100mg)의 80~180%
5. 비타민B1 : 표시량(1.2mg/1100mg)의 80~180%
6. 비타민B6 : 표시량(1.5mg/1100mg)의 80~150%
7. 비타민B12 : 표시량(2.4ug/1100mg)의 80~180%
8. 비타민K : 표시량(70ug/1100mg)의 80~180%
9. 마그네슘 : 표시량(100mg/1100mg) 80~150%
10. 망간 : 표시량(10mg/1100mg)의 80~150%
11. 대장균군 : 음성

source.caution:
1. 과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의할 것
2. 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담할 것
3. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
4. 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
5. 손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
6. 항응고제 등 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것

김지웅원장의 올인원 멀티영양제Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K

Made by 주식회사 해나눔 청운지점 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 100mg of Magnesium, 10mg of Manganese, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 500mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 70μg of Vitamin K as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 100mg Magnesium, 10mg Manganese, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 500mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 70μg Vitamin K
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 해나눔 청운지점

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed for bone formation
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

  • Those who want to take Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
